note: Compositional Procurement Ontology. Four EXPLICIT levels: sector -> family -> category -> intent. Terms are three-tier (strong decides / weak+context decides / weak alone never decides) and inherit down the chain. Veto is declared at sector or family level and inherited; an intent only adds its own exceptions. FACETS carry all variation (dimensions, grades, capacities, model numbers) and each declares supplier_pool_affecting, which sibling caches key on. Never add an entry per product SKU. IDs in this file are NOT a hardcodable list: consumers must read them through listIntentIds()/listFamilyIds()/listOntologyIds() (or scripts/ontology-ids.mjs) and compare ontology_version, because intents split and any copied list rots silently. This file must stay byte-identical between farqconstraction/src/lib and farq/api/lib/construction.

morphology_rule.note: ARABIC INFLECTION, TREATED AS A CLASS. Three rounds in a row lost an intent to Arabic morphology and each was closed on its own — «باب خشب / خشبي», «اسمني / اسمنتي», «امبير» absent while `a` was present. The distinction that closes them together is the one the language itself makes, and it is recorded here because it governs how every term in this payload matches.

inflection.definition: Changes the FORM of a word and keeps its meaning. One lexeme, so matching across the forms is always right and the rule generates them freely.
handled: proclitics — the conjunctions و/ف and the definite article in its attached forms
sound feminine plural — «لوحة» → «لوحات», which REPLACES the taa marbuta rather than following it
inflection.attribution_rule: When both «X» and «Xة» are vocabulary, «Xات» is attributed to the FEMININE and withheld from the bare noun. «لوح» sheet pluralises to «ألواح»; «لوحات» is the plural of «لوحة» board. One attribution both gained «لوحة» its plural and took «لوحات توزيع» away from «لوح» — two entries on the collision list that pointed at each other.

derivation.definition: Builds a NEW word from an old one. The nisba does this: «خشب» wood → «خشبي» wooden, «أرض» ground → «أرضية» flooring, «معدن» metal → «معدني», which also means mineral. The result is a different lexeme that may name a different product, so generating it is a guess rather than a transformation.
derivation.gate: A derived form is generated only where no family already owns it that does not also own the base. Computed from this payload's own ownership — there is no exception list, by the same discipline the guard predicate runs under.
derivation.phrase_exemption: Inside a MULTI-WORD term the derivation is free, because the neighbouring word has already pinned the trade. «زجاج» alone reaching «زجاجي» is a guess — «صوف زجاجي» is insulation and «ألياف زجاجية» is an admixture. «باب زجاج» reaching «باب زجاجي» is one product written two ways, which is «باب خشب / باب خشبي» exactly. Gating the word in isolation cost «باب زجاجي سحاب» its family on evidence from phrases where the head was doing the work all along.

out_of_scope.broken_plural: NOT REACHABLE, and the limit is stated rather than left to be discovered. «حريق» → «حرائق», «لوح» → «ألواح», «كتاب» → «كتب»: the plural is formed by re-templating the root, not by adding to it, so no affix rule can reach it — not this one and not a longer suffix list. Broken plurals are VOCABULARY. «حرايق» was listed in v9 for this reason. A reader who assumes plurals are handled is half right, and the wrong half is silent, so a test enforces this limit instead of a comment describing it.
out_of_scope.also_out_of_scope: Internal orthographic variation that is not affixal — «اسمني» for «اسمنتي» — which v8 closed as a class by removing adjacency rather than by morphology.

measured.added_note: All eight are sound feminine plurals where base and plural are genuinely one lexeme — «لوحة»→«لوحات إنذار حريق», «بطاقة»→«قارئ بطاقات», «أرضية»→«هاردنر أرضيات». Every one was checked at LINE level and resolves to the correct family, because the head concept decides there. Term-level collision count is an upper bound on risk, not a prediction of behaviour.
measured.removed_note: Includes all three glass/mineral-fibre collisions — «زجاج» reaching «ألياف زجاجية», «خزان ألياف زجاجية» and «صوف زجاجي» — which is the case that had bitten three times.

supplier_clause_rule.note: THE QUESTION TRANSFERS BETWEEN REGISTERS; THE RULE DOES NOT. Supplier prose is asked the same thing a BOQ line is — may this term name a product here — but the attribute-clause rule answers it using a premise that only a BOQ line satisfies: a product head with its attributes trailing behind it. Company prose has no product head. Applying the BOQ vocabulary to it was measurably worse than applying nothing: «مؤسسة الحماية من الحريق — رشاشات حريق ومضخات» scored 0 while the same business written «الحماية ضد الحريق» scored 23, and «شركة مكافحة الحرائق في الرياض» was zeroed by a preposition. So this register gets its own vocabulary, derived the same way the BOQ openers were — from the register itself, and falsified against it.
supplier_clause_rule.note_index_0: The BOQ rule refuses to open a clause at index 0, because a keyword with nothing before it IS the product. Prose has no such guarantee: a record may begin with a concatenated field label. The policy is therefore declared per register rather than assumed, so that it is already settled when a prose opener is eventually earned.

derivation.corpus: 10,104 real supplier records (name_ar + name_en + supplied_items_text + business_type)
derivation.result: EMPTY. Every BOQ opener is either absent from this register or inverted by it, and no replacement construction was found.
derivation.verdict: An empty vocabulary is the derived answer, not a deferral. It is recorded with its counts so that a future reader can see the measurement rather than assume the work was skipped.

rejected_openers.note: Every candidate that was measured and refused, with the count that refused it. The first group is the BOQ vocabulary; the second is constructions specific to prose, tried because the first failed.

openers.reason: INVERTED, and this is the finding. In an Arabic company name «لـ» introduces the trade the company IS: «مؤسسة النجم للتبريد والتكييف». The top continuations are للتجاره×751, للمشاريع×623, للتبريد×619, للادوات×387, للتكييف×250, للاسمنت×210, للرخام×193, للبلاستيك×177 — every one of them a trade being claimed, not an attribute being described. In 6,298 occurrences this opener suppresses exactly the words that identify the supplier.
Locational, not attributive: بالرياض×37, بالدخول×27, بالدمام×2, بالجمله×2. This is the opener that zeroed «شركة مكافحة الحرائق بالرياض».
Both occurrences are «لالواح» — the company's own product line.
Locational or topical: «في الدمام», «في الرياض», «في مجال السلامة». Never introduces an attribute.
«الوقاية من الحريق» and «الحماية من الحريق» ARE the trade; «من الباب الى الباب» is a logistics phrase. This is the opener that zeroed a qualified fire-protection supplier.
Absent. So are تصنيف, تشطيب, توصيل, مقاس, سماكه, وزن, سعه, كثافه, جهد, مطابق, حسب, مع, عن, الى — zero occurrences each in 10,104 records.

All seven are company names («عرض لايكا»). The same is true of every other BOQ key with a nonzero count: تيار×2 («تيار البرق للطاقة»), نمط×2, ربط×1 («ربط الكهرباء»), لون×1, درجه×1, طراز×1, قطر×1 (Qatar), عمق×1, قدره×1. Nonzero does not mean attributive; here it means false positive.
Prose-specific candidate. «بديل الرخام والخشب» is a marble-and-wood SUBSTITUTE — the company's actual product. Claiming it is correct.
Prose-specific candidate. «غير متوفر» and «القطاع غير الربحي». Neither introduces a clause.
Prose-specific candidate. «مؤسسة بدون تردد للتكييف» — a company name.

Prose-specific candidates that do not occur at all: عدا, ما عدا, باستثناء, لصالح, عملاء, مثل, مشابه, النشاط, التصنيف, الفئه, القسم, except, excluding, other than, clients, similar to, such as, category, classification.

clause_rule.note: Vocabulary of the attribute-clause rule. This lives in the PAYLOAD, not in resolver code, for two reasons. First, a rule adopted on one observation must not read like a measured one, so every opener carries its own evidence count and provisional flag here rather than in a handoff note. Second, any consumer that reads this payload — including the supply side — gets the vocabulary instead of hand-copying it, which is how the two sides drifted apart between v6 and v7. Semantics: a term may decide only if its match STARTS outside every attribute clause. A separate-token opener is NOT part of the value it introduces and contributes its END as the value start; a proclitic is glued to its value and contributes its own start.

provisional_review.meaning: An opener marked provisional was adopted on too few observations to be called measured. It is kept because its error direction is safe: an opener that fires wrongly suppresses a term, which falls back to a shallower level rather than hijacking the line. Re-derive every provisional opener once roughly this many real booklet lines have been seen, and either clear the flag with the count that earned it or drop the opener.

preposition_clause_keys.note: Closed-class standalone prepositions, which can never be a product head. «على» is deliberately absent: unattested in the derivation set and it collides («العمل على الارتفاعات», «التعرف على الوجه»).

proclitic_clause_openers.note: لـ/بـ fused with the definite article, which cannot be confused with a noun's own first letters. min_stem is the floor on what follows the proclitic, and it is what makes each one safe.

openers.evidence: «لألواح الجبس» — the same لـ+الـ construction written with a hamza-initial noun, so it normalises to «لال». ONE observation. Requiring all three letters is what keeps it from swallowing «لاصق».
«بالبوليستر», «بالأبواب». TWO observations. The stem floor keeps «بالته» — a pallet, not بـ+الـ+noun — from opening a clause over its own name.

rejected_openers.note: Recorded because the refusals are the evidence that this vocabulary was derived rather than guessed. Do not re-adopt these without new counts.

openers.reason: Mostly prepositional, but the 2 failures were «لياسة» and «لوحات» — the plaster family's own term and the distribution-board term. Adopting it would have suppressed both.

fire_fighting_supplier.note_patterns: «حرائق» is the BROKEN plural of «حريق», and a broken plural cannot be derived by suffixing the way the nisba and «ات» rules derive theirs — it has to be listed. «شركة مكافحة الحرائق» was reported as a casualty of the supply-side chokepoint; it was not. It scored zero before the chokepoint existed, for this reason.

term_guards.note: «قطاع»/«زاويه» name a SHAPE, so they decide only with real structural evidence. A 0.45 mm galvanized drywall stud is a section by shape and a gypsum product by trade — it must never reach a steel stockist.

intents.note: Cold-formed sections are a DIFFERENT TRADE from hot-rolled structural steel — roll-formers and purlin mills, not steel stockists — and the held-out corpus found the whole steel-structures sector 100% unusable on 4,914 rows of exactly this product, because «قطاعات باردة التشكيل» only ever matched the generic weak «قطاع» and never named a family.

term_guards.note: An electrical enclosure is MADE OF sheet steel but is not sheet steel; it is bought from a panel builder, not a steel stockist.

intents.note: Reached the family through «درابزين» but produced no intent, and a glass balustrade reached nothing at all because `glass` pulled to glazing. Balustrades are a metal-fabrication trade whichever infill they carry.

term_guards.note: «Twinwall» describes a twin-walled EXTRUSION, which is polycarbonate roofing sheet in the envelope trade and HDPE conduit in the electrical trade. Exposed once conduit stopped being read as water pipe.

intents.note_terms: These are the materials this tile is MADE of, and the metal-ceiling guard next door declines on them. A family that discriminates using a word has to own that word, or the guard reads as though it were steering the line out of the family — and mirroring it upward on that mistaken reading sent «سقف مستعار صوف صخري» to a thermal-insulation supplier instead of a ceiling-tile one. Context tier, so they never decide alone.

term_guards.note: A METAL CEILING TILE IS A DIFFERENT SUPPLIER — a roll-former, not a mineral-fibre distributor. The material word is the discriminator in every language, so the guard names materials rather than phrasings; the first attempt keyed on «معدني» alone and the defect returned as soon as a batch wrote `Galvanized Steel`.
«الياف معدنيه» is MINERAL fibre. Reading «معدنيه» as metal is the mistake this whole round exists to stop, so the metal side declines the tile whenever the material is named as a fibre or a plaster.

intents.note: «سقف معدني مستعار» never matched the family's «سقف مستعار» because ARABIC PUTS THE ADJECTIVE BETWEEN THE NOUN AND ITS QUALIFIER, and a two-word phrase term requires the two words to be adjacent. Metal ceilings also genuinely belong to a different supplier — a metal-ceiling roll-former, not a mineral-fibre tile distributor — so they earn an intent of their own rather than a longer alias list on the tile intent.
The family was reached through «جبس» but no intent existed, so a gypsum board could not key a board supplier's pool — the family-right / intent-absent shape that reads as coverage.

term_guards.note: The intent carried this guard and the FAMILY did not, so «لاصق رخام» still resolved to a tiling supplier instead of an adhesives one. Same defect as the sprinkler: a guard is only as good as its coverage of the nodes that carry the word.
Stone names the MATERIAL in «ألياف بازلت» and «لاصق رخام»; the product is the fibre and the adhesive.

A cantilever arm on a STRUT channel is a support bracket, not warehouse racking, and it is bought from the channel-support supplier. Warehouse racking keeps the word whenever the line is about pallets, bays or uprights.

A beam clamp sold for a STRUT or pipe-support system is a fixing, not rigging equipment; a rigger's beam clamp names a working load instead. Lifting gear keeps the word whenever the line is about slings, hoists or loads.

intents.note: Named by function, not by body material or connection type — `Lug` in «توصيل Lug» is how a body is JOINED, and matching it sent 64 of these to cable terminations.

term_guards.note: Product-head rule: insulation FOR pipes, a hanger FOR pipes and a clamp FOR pipes are not pipes — the pipe is the object, not the purchase. The rule is positional, so «ماسورة معزولة» (pre-insulated pipe) is still a pipe. Separately, electrical conduit shares the word «ماسورة» with water pipe and belongs to the electrical trade.
«meter» must not claim electrical metering, which is a switchgear/metering trade with a different supplier pool.

THE SAME GUARD THE INTENT CARRIES, AT EVERY NODE THAT CARRIES THE WORD. Guarding only the intent left English `sprinkler` deciding the FAMILY and the CATEGORY unguarded, so «Irrigation Sprinkler Head» still reached fire_fighting at 0.90 while Arabic «رشاش» was correctly refused at intent level. The asymmetry was never really about language: it was about which node happened to get the fix. A term guarded on one node and free on its own ancestor is the same bug in a costume.

FIRE AND IRRIGATION BOTH SELL SPRINKLERS; THE TRADES DO NOT OVERLAP. «رشاش» and `sprinkler` are now BOTH strong, because a concept's right to decide must never depend on which language the buyer writes in — the previous split (strong `sprinkler`, weak «رشاش») produced the worst possible inversion: every irrigation pop-up head resolved as a FIRE sprinkler at 0.90 while real fire sprinklers written in Arabic resolved to nothing. Parity alone would only move the error, so the shared word is guarded by trade: a landscape or drip context disowns the word and irrigation_emitter claims it with its own positive vocabulary. A fire-sprinkler line names its head type or K-factor, never a lawn.

THE SAME GUARD THE INTENT CARRIES, AT EVERY NODE THAT CARRIES THE WORD. Guarding only the intent left English `sprinkler` deciding the FAMILY and the CATEGORY unguarded, so «Irrigation Sprinkler Head» still reached fire_fighting at 0.90 while Arabic «رشاش» was correctly refused one level down. The asymmetry was never really about language — it was about which node happened to get the fix. A term guarded on one node and free on its own ancestor is the same bug in a costume.
«حريق» used adjectivally states a fire RATING of some other product (a board, a door, a cable). A rating is not a fire-fighting product.

Mirrored from the intent below, and the reason is the point of the predicate that now enforces it: a guard that declines on ANOTHER trade's words is a trade guard, and an unmirrored trade guard leaks — the intent abstains and the family claims the line anyway. That is exactly how «sprinkler» kept reaching fire_fighting. Depth guards, which block only on this family's own words, need no mirror because the family is the honest fallback.

An ENCLOSURE IS A PRODUCT WITH A TRADE, not a shape. Electrical enclosures were the single largest unusable group in the held-out corpus — 7,824 rows that matched the bare word «enclosure» owned by the IT-rack family, found no rack context, and settled into a family = null semantic recovery: nominally resolved, countable as coverage, and unable to name a single supplier. Giving the electrical sector its own claim on the word makes those lines poolable; the guard hands the word back to racks_enclosures whenever the line is actually about a server cabinet.

intents.note_terms: A buyer writing English names the device («MCCB 100A»); a buyer writing Arabic names the RATING («قاطع 100 امبير»). Same purchase, unequal authority — the asymmetry that has now been found in concepts, in morphology, and here in units. The discriminator the trade itself uses is the rating, so the IEC 60947-2 frame series is the context. It is a closed standard series, not booklet wording. The guard is what carries the rule: a bare «قاطع» inherits «امبير» from the family, so without require_any it would claim every breaker line that mentions amps.

term_guards.note: block_any names the other devices that are also «قاطع». Their own strong terms normally win on specificity, but a rating in range must never be enough on its own to call an earth-leakage or air circuit breaker an MCCB.

intents.note_terms: The IEC 60898 rating series, 6–63A. Ratings between 63A and 100A are deliberately in NEITHER series: an 80A breaker is genuinely either an MCB or an MCCB, so those lines stop at family, which is the honest answer rather than a coin toss at 0.90 confidence.

«قاطع عزل» is an ordinary way to say isolator, and it needs to be THIS family's vocabulary rather than a bare «عزل» sitting in the breaker guards. Bare «عزل» is insulation's word, and borrowing it cost «قاطع 32 امبير عزل مزدوج» its intent.

term_guards.note: The plain words are the FINAL board; a main switchboard is a different product and a different supplier tier, so a line naming «رييسيه» or `MDB` stays at the family rather than claiming this intent.

Fibre and structured cabling are a different trade and a different supplier pool from power cable. «كابل» stays fully decisive for copper power cable — it only steps aside when the line itself says fibre or data.

Low voltage is the DEFAULT reading of a power cable, so it must yield whenever the line names a more specific type. Without this, «كابل Cu/PVC Control» reads as LV power cable and the RFQ reaches the wrong cable specialists.

intents.note: Track lighting was the largest single unusable category in the lighting sector of the held-out corpus (1,512 of 1,980 rows), and the Arabic transliteration «تراك لايت» is how the trade actually writes it — the family already knew «داون لايت» and «سبوت لايت» in the same transliterated style, so its absence was an omission rather than a design choice. Facets are inherited from the family, as every sibling luminaire intent does.

term_guards.note: Mirrored from the intent below, and the reason is the point of the predicate that now enforces it: a guard that declines on ANOTHER trade's words is a trade guard, and an unmirrored trade guard leaks — the intent abstains and the family claims the line anyway. That is exactly how «sprinkler» kept reaching fire_fighting. Depth guards, which block only on this family's own words, need no mirror because the family is the honest fallback.
A filter is only a respirator filter with respiratory evidence. Irrigation, HVAC, oil and fuel filters are entirely different trades that share the bare word «filter».

categories.label_ar: معدات الإنقاذ من المرتفعات والأماكن المحصورة

term_guards.note: «socket» is a wrench insert only in a tool context; in plumbing the same word is a pipe socket, and «file»/«key»/«saw» are ordinary English words before they are tools.

Mirrored from the intent below, and the reason is the point of the predicate that now enforces it: a guard that declines on ANOTHER trade's words is a trade guard, and an unmirrored trade guard leaks — the intent abstains and the family claims the line anyway. That is exactly how «sprinkler» kept reaching fire_fighting. Depth guards, which block only on this family's own words, need no mirror because the family is the honest fallback.
A cable TESTER is an instrument, not a cable. The cable is the object the instrument acts on, exactly as in «عزل مواسير» and «حامل ماسورة».

intents.note: The printer, never the card it prints: a card-printer supplier is not a blank-card supplier. Blank PVC cards are the sibling intent pvc_cards in card_consumables, same family, different pool.

term_guards.note: The card, never the printer that prints it nor the reader that reads it: those are card_printers and the access-control credentials, each its own supplier pool.

intents.note: Split from card_printers in cpo-v11: a supplier who sells card printers is not thereby a supplier of blank cards, and matching runs on the intent.

categories.note: Blank cards are a consumables trade. A card-printer supplier is ALLOWED here (it often stocks cards) but never PREFERRED: preference belongs to the supplier who names the cards.

term_guards.note: Elastomeric names a polymer shared with paints and membranes.

A glass door on a network rack is a FEATURE OF THE RACK, not a glazing item — the same defect class as a material or a location naming the product. Architectural glass doors keep the term; IT enclosures that merely have one do not.

intents.note: CORRUGATED WALL PLUS AN SN STIFFNESS CLASS IS A BURIED-DRAINAGE DESIGNATION — SN4/SN8/SN16 is ring stiffness for gravity sewer, a rating no pressure plumbing pipe carries. These 90 rows sat in `pipes_fittings` because «ماسوره» is that family's strong term and nothing else competed; the trade is a drainage pipe extruder, not a plumbing fittings distributor. This cell was in the held-out report's four SENSITIVITY cells rather than its seven adjudicated ones, which is why a re-measurement scoped to the seven returned zero and missed it.

intents.note_terms: «بلوك مفرغ» is already a strong term, so «بلوك اسمني مفرغ» failed for ONE reason: the misspelling sits between the two words and breaks adjacency. The fix is compositional rather than lexical — hollow/solid is what distinguishes this intent from lightweight and clay blocks, so «بلوك» + that context decides regardless of which adjective, or misspelling, sits in the middle. The typo «اسمني» is NOT in the vocabulary; it does not need to be. «بلوك خفيف مفرغ» still reaches lightweight_block because a strong term outranks a weak one.

A MATERIAL PHRASE DOES NOT NAME A TRADE. Glass fibre is a concrete admixture, a GRP tank, a grating and a roof sheet; mineral fibre is a ceiling tile, an insulation batt and a concrete fibre. Whichever trade holds the bare phrase in its strong tier wins every line that never mentions a product — which is how «خزان ألياف زجاجية» reached an admixture supplier. Bare materials are therefore weak everywhere and the product head decides.

intents.note: A CHANNEL-SUPPORT SYSTEM IS ITS OWN TRADE, and the accessories that bolt onto it carry names other trades also use: a «Cantilever Arm» is warehouse racking to a racking supplier and a strut bracket to a support supplier, and a «Beam Clamp» is lifting gear to a rigger and a strut fixing to an installer. The held-out corpus found 48 such rows going to the warehouse and rigging families. Naming the system positively lets the line say which arm it means, and the guards on the two competing claims stop them answering when the line has already said «strut».

Irrigation must claim its own sprinklers POSITIVELY, not merely lose them. Guarding the word «رشاش»/`sprinkler` on the fire side only stops the wrong answer; without head names the landscape trade uses — pop-up, rotor, impact, gear drive — a garden line would fall to an honest but useless unknown instead of reaching an irrigation supplier.

families.note: THE ENTIRE `floor` / `ceiling` / `aluminium` ERROR FAMILY ON BATCHES 11-20 WAS THIS ONE MISSING PRODUCT. 1,449 covers became floor tiling on the word `floor` in `Floor-to-Floor`, 720 became interior systems on `Ceiling Joint`, and 331 became facade systems on «مادة Aluminium» — a location or a material naming the product because the product itself was unknown to the ontology. Stopping the stray word from deciding is only half the fix; the real product must also be able to claim its own line. It is its own family rather than an intent under floor_tiling because a ceiling joint cover is not flooring and the profile manufacturers are a distinct trade.

THE MOST COMMON ITEM IN GENERAL CONTRACTING ANYWHERE, and it had no family. The `ready_mix_supplier` archetype existed from the first version, which says the SUPPLY side was modelled and the demand side never was — the clearest evidence that cpo-v5's families were catalogue and MEP shaped while real booklet lines are civil. «خرسانة جاهزة» resolved to C. Grade is a facet, not an intent: a ready-mix plant that batches C25 batches C40, so splitting per grade would fragment one supplier pool into twenty.

A quarry and crusher trade with no representation on either side, so `aggregate_supplier` is new here — unlike ready-mix, where the archetype already existed. «بحص» and «رمل» are two-word booklet staples that resolved to C.

term_guards.note: «سن» is a size of crushed aggregate in the trade and an ordinary word everywhere else, so it needs quarry context before it may decide.

families.note: Rendering is its own trade and its own material, and the booklet register is full of it — «لياسة», «طرطشة», «بياض», «بلاستر». `cement_supplier` already carried «بلاستر» and «مونه» patterns, so no archetype was invented. «جبس بلاستر» moved here from cement_binders/mortar_screed: gypsum plaster is rendering, not screed, and one phrasing should not sit in two families.

Car-park shades, tensile canopies and privacy screens are a specialist trade with neither family nor archetype before now, so `shade_structure_supplier` is new. «مظلات مواقف سيارات» is one of the most-tendered external-works items in the Gulf and resolved to C.

term_guards.note: A generator canopy is the acoustic enclosure around a genset, sold by a generator supplier. Same word, different trade.

families.note: Blue Pages has four furniture activities (أثاث مكتبي، أثاث خشبي، أثاث ومفروشات، أثاث - صناع) and our catalogue had no family for any of them, so every furniture line fell through to joinery or to nothing. Loose furniture is a different trade from fixed joinery: a desk supplier is not a door-leaf factory.

term_guards.note: «أثاث الطرق» is signage and street furniture, a different family.
A workbench or tool cabinet belongs to workshop fit-out, not to office furniture.

families.note: «سقالات» was an unmapped Blue Pages activity. Scaffolding, shoring props and ladders are bought as materials on almost every site and had no family, so the lines resolved to structural steel and reached the wrong suppliers.

term_guards.note: «سلم كابلات» is a cable ladder tray, an electrical accessory, not an access ladder.
«سلم متحرك» is an escalator and belongs to vertical transport.
A pipe coupling and a rebar coupler share the word with the scaffold coupler.

families.note: «مصاعد وسلالم كهربائية» was unmapped. A lift is a named package in most building tenders and the supplier pool (lift agents) shares nothing with electrical distribution, so it needs its own family rather than falling into motors or switchgear.

term_guards.note: A forklift or a hoist is material handling, not a building lift.

families.note: «كوالين وأقفال» was mapped to fasteners, which is wrong: a lock and cylinder trader is not a bolt and anchor trader. Door hardware is a schedule of its own in every fit-out tender.

term_guards.note: A locknut or lock washer is a fastener, not door hardware.
«Hardware» alone also names IT equipment.
A gas cylinder is welding and cutting equipment, not door hardware.

families.note: «مواتير كهربائية» was mapped to motor_control and pumps, both wrong: a VFD panel builder does not sell motors, and a motor is bought as a bare machine. Motor control (starters, drives) stays a separate family.

term_guards.note: A drive, starter or contactor is motor control, a different supplier pool.
A diesel engine or genset is not an electric motor.
A gate or shutter motor is sold with the door, by the door supplier.
Oxygen for welding is gas-cutting equipment; the same word, a different trade entirely.

families.note: Radiation shielding, hermetic doors, scrub sinks and antibacterial wall systems are a hospital trade of their own. They were reaching nobody: the list had no word for any of them.

term_guards.note: A lead-acid battery is not radiation shielding.
A distribution board and a kitchen unit are also «خزانة».
A quarry belt conveyor is a different trade from baggage handling.

families.note: Every recent government and campus tender prices panels, inverters and mounting, and the catalogue had no word for any of them.

term_guards.note: An inverter welder and an inverter air conditioner are not solar inverters.

families.note: «معدات مطابخ ومطاعم» is 1,231 companies in the directory and the catalogue had no family to point them at.

term_guards.note: A fitted kitchen in wood is joinery; this family is the stainless equipment.
